findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "assay_preflight" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: assay_probe, assay_get_ledger_policy · Private data: assay_probe · Public sink: assay_probe, assay_get_ledger_policy · Destructive: assay_preflight, assay_probe, assay_verify_delivery, assay_get_ledger_policy.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: assay_probe, assay_get_ledger_policy · Private data: assay_probe · Public sink: assay_probe, assay_get_ledger_policy · Destructive: assay_preflight, assay_probe, assay_verify_delivery, assay_get_ledger_policy

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
